config_name: iPad Air 13-inch — M4 8-core CPU / 9-core GPU, 12GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 13" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C (USB 3 10Gb/s, DisplayPort), magnetic Magic Keyboard connector, Smart Connector
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard for iPad Air 13" included in price: scissor keys with full function row (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge

battery.notes: 36.59Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi (9h cellular); users report ~8-8.5h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Tablet-only $1,449.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Air 13" $399.99 (BBY 19204078). BBY sale: tablet $1,299.99 (reg $1,449.99) → ~$1,699 with keyboard. Cellular variant +$200 ($1,649 tablet). Pencil Pro not included.

offers.name: Apple iPad Air M4 13" 256GB with Wi-Fi 7 (8th Generation) - Space Grey

reviews.quote: The fiercest competitor for the iPad Pro is home-made. Pros: brute top performance, WiFi very fast, high-quality unibody chassis, USB-C with 10 GBit/s, two external displays possible, good color accuracy (PWM-free), well-balanced speakers, high recycled content. Cons: slow 60 Hz display, battery charging takes time, SoC throttles under sustained load. (NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026; 11" shares SoC and chassis design.)

praises: M4 with 12GB unified memory is overkill-fast for tablet tasks — LumaFusion and DaVinci iPad multitrack 4K edits with no app reloads (r/ipad)
13" at 616g/6.1mm is the best big-screen-to-weight trade in the lineup; noticeably lighter than any 13" laptop
Air Magic Keyboard has a full function-key row and glass trackpad — more laptop-like than the old Air keyboard
Wi-Fi 7 + USB-C 6K@60 external display support works well in Stage Manager for a desktop-ish setup
Fanless and completely silent even under sustained export/render loads
complaints: 60Hz refresh is the #1 gripe — no ProMotion at $1,449 feels like the one deliberate cut vs the Pro (r/ipad)
LCD blacks look grey in dark rooms; no OLED/HDR after using any tandem-OLED Pro
$399.99 Magic Keyboard has unlit keys — same complaint as the Pro keyboard at nearly the price
256GB fills fast with 4K video projects; storage upgrades are expensive soldered tiers
iPadOS still lacks full desktop-class apps (Xcode, full Excel macros) — the ceiling every iPad review repeats

design_philosophy: The Air is Apple's 'right iPad for most people': near-Pro M4-class performance, the Pro's thin-and-light chassis language, and the Pro's keyboard/pen accessory ecosystem at roughly 70% of Pro money — paid for with a 60Hz laminated LCD instead of tandem OLED/ProMotion and USB-C 10Gb/s instead of Thunderbolt. The 13" 256GB is the sweet-spot config of the line and the one closest to the launch-review configuration.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026 (87%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Line anchor config. Ecosystem 6.5 (~9 casual/creative, ~5-6 desktop-app parity). Battery rated on ~8.3h real use, not the 10h claim. Upgradability 1.0: everything soldered. Image URL is BBY CDN best guess.
standouts: Best price-to-performance big-screen tablet in Canada: M4 + 12GB + 13" for $1,849 with keyboard
Full function-row Magic Keyboard included in the priced bundle
Fanless silence with laptop-class burst performance
dealbreakers: If you've used 120Hz ProMotion, the 60Hz panel will bother you — pay up for the Pro
Dark-room media watching is mediocre on this LCD vs OLED
